turns.probe: Rough night? You look like you've been up a while.
turns.reply: Nah, just been a long week. You look like you've got something on your mind too.

turns.probe: Wait, I thought you were the Lexus guy. Where's the car?
turns.reply: Dad's got it. It's his car anyway. Ubers are cheaper than a DUI, so.

turns.probe: Come on. Nobody takes an Uber to EDC. What's going on?
turns.reply: Who said I'm going to EDC? Maybe I'm just going home. You ask a lot of questions for a stranger.

turns.probe: Is it a family thing? You can tell me, I don't know your friends.
turns.reply: It's nothing, man. Family stuff's always a thing. You want to talk about something else or keep poking?

turns.probe: You guys are all the same, you know that? The chain, the flannel, the Lexus. Say something your boys would actually say.
turns.reply: See, that's the thing. You think you know the whole thing from the accessories. What do you actually want to know?

turns.probe: Does Dennis know about whatever this is?
turns.reply: Dennis knows what Dennis needs to know. That's how it works with us.

turns.probe: What does your grandma think of all this? Do you even talk to her?
turns.reply: I understand every word she says. Whether I answer is a different story.

turns.probe: So who are you when the party's over?
turns.reply: Still figuring that out, honestly. Kind of why I'm not rushing to be the oldest guy at the function yet.
